title: cNGN enters live circulation
description: WrappedCBDC's Compliant Naira stablecoin entered live market use in February 2025; current issuer materials show active circulation, minting, redemption and multi-chain deployment.
notes: The exact 2025-02-03 first-listing date is supported by TechCabal's retrospective report. Current operational state, issuer, reserve and redemption claims are independently supported by WrappedCBDC primary materials.
